standard_prerequisites.name: Elements of ordinals are ordinals
standard_prerequisites.use: Left-to-right direction (line 539): an ordinal's transitivity and element-ordinality give the forward inclusion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Transfinite induction schema
standard_prerequisites.use: Right-to-left (line 541): one of the two inputs showing membership well-orders the transitive set A.

standard_prerequisites.name: Trichotomy for ordinal membership
standard_prerequisites.use: Right-to-left (line 541): the second input, giving the linear-order half of the well-order claim.

core_obligations: Forward direction (proof line 539): a one-line reduction to the member-is-ordinal lemma.
Backward direction (lines 540-542): if A is transitive and consists of ordinals, membership well-orders A by the induction schema plus trichotomy, exactly the unit's definition of ordinal.
proof_roadmap: For the forward inclusion cite the element-ordinality lemma.
For the converse assemble the well-order from induction and trichotomy over the transitive set.
difficulty_reason: The working characterisation of ordinals (statement 534-535, proof 538-542), used throughout the section. Each direction is one to two lines delegating to two named lemmas; the content lives in correctly identifying which named results give which halves of the definition. H2: a two-line bridge corollary.
